## Requirements (from the ticket)

1. **§15.1 landing** — the twelve-section marketing page at `/` (nav → hero → dossier → workflow
   strip → author's seat → voices → live runs → models → proof → pricing → changelog/FAQ → final
   CTA), dark-default with a real light theme from the same tokens, no wrong-theme flash; hero
   drop-zone (≤10 MB, .md/.docx/.pdf + paste) holding the file client-side and continuing after
   auth into a project; the invite machinery stays at `/invite`; copy passes the honest-marketing
   lints (no generation promises in hero/proof, no detection-evasion, no placeholder logos, no
   unbuilt-asset claims, no unflagged comparatives; the headline is the locked §15.1 string).
2. **§15.2 pricing** — `/pricing` derived from `pricing.json` + `cost_per_verified_claim`: plan
   ladder (Free honesty split, Writer/Studio/Studio Max, Team waitlist), annual toggle showing the
   15% in dollars, essay-led cost cards + voice-profile card + quick-review line (ranges, never a
   single figure), the full model-tier matrix, the generated FAQ; a hand-edited figure fails a
   contract test.
3. **§15.3 onboarding** — self-serve `/signup` (Google + magic link, invite code optional in open
   mode), the "we sent you a link" wait screen showing the fixture dossier, three onboarding
   entries (scratch / upload outline / upload draft), Ask≠Run, pre-filled approvals, zero
   unnecessary modals; REQ-CHAT-30's activation event emitted at the outline-approval seam.
4. **§15.4 Showcase** — one deterministic fixture dossier seeded per account at $0: outline, v1,
   full-board dossier (letter + claim ledger with real fetched URLs + discourse report +
   second-read reconciliation + ≥1 contradicted tier-1 claim), triage ledger, v2, response letter;
   read-only artifacts, runs blocked inline, Duplicate → normal project, archive/restore, not
   deletable; precedence: dropped file wins → Showcase is the second row, else the Showcase
   dossier opens first on finding 1.
5. **§3.5 events** — `landing.viewed`, `landing.dropzone_used`, `signup.completed`,
   `email.verified`, `entry.chosen`, `showcase.opened`, `showcase.finding_anchor_viewed`,
   `paywall.shown`, `outline.approved` (the activation event) + the existing run/trial events —
   all through the validated envelope + opt-out.
6. **Deterministic harness** — showcase-seed tests, drop→signup→project precedence, and the
   "8k .docx renders the preview < 20 s" leg via the in-memory converter (the live Job's wall-clock
   bound is Stage B).

## Plan

- **`@rhema/contracts`** — `domain/pricing-page.ts` (`buildPricingPageData()`: ladder, cost cards,
  matrix, FAQ — every figure derived); `growth-lint.ts` (`lintGrowthCopy` — hero/proof generation
  bans, detection-evasion ban, locked headline, unbuilt-asset + comparative gates behind
  `COMPARATIVE_WAVE_MET=false`); `showcase-fixture.ts` (`assertShowcaseFixture` — REQ-POS-3's
  ≥1 contradicted tier-1 + fetched-URL check); `analytics.ts` (add `outline.approved`,
  client-mintable `showcase.finding_anchor_viewed`); `pricing.json` += `costCardTerms` +
  `modelTierMultipliers` (the §12.2 public forms the cards derive from — validated).
- **`@rhema/db`** — migration `0037_showcase.sql` (`projects.showcase`, `acquisition_events`);
  `seed/showcase.ts` — `SHOWCASE_FIXTURE` + `seedShowcaseProject()` (idempotent: project, drafts
  v1/v2, outline + letter artifacts w/ content-addressed bytes when a store binds, review +
  response correspondence, delivered run + steps, findings, claims + claim_sources, fetch_log,
  obligations).
- **`apps/api`** — `provisionPersonalAccount` seeds the Showcase; guards: run create → 409
  `showcase_read_only`, delete → 409 `showcase_not_deletable`, draft/outline/disposition writes →
  409; Duplicate copies content as a normal project; `GET /showcase` (slug + run id + first
  finding + opened flag); emissions: `entry.chosen` (POST /projects), `showcase.opened` (first
  dossier read), `outline.approved` (gate-decision seam), `paywall.shown` (sheet-context when the
  entitlement gate blocks); `POST /analytics/acquisition` (unauthed, whitelisted events only,
  per-IP throttled, no PII — landing.viewed/dropzone_used pre-auth).
- **`apps/web`** — `marketing.tsx` (the 12 sections + drop-zone + LCP/CLS-conscious static SSR +
  `client/landing.ts` island: IndexedDB hold → `/signup?intent=review&held=1`, then `/app/new?held=1`
  picks it up via DataTransfer; finding-anchor beacon lives inline on the dossier page); `/pricing`
  + `/signup` surfaces in the same module; signup intent passthrough + showcase-preview wait screen;
  `/` landing, `/pricing`, `/signup` routes, `/invite` retained; `GET /app` first-screen precedence
  (carried intent > unopened only-child Showcase dossier > the row list); `POST /a/landing` +
  `POST /a/acq` relays; showcase "Worked example" row badge + read-only banner on its dossier;
  `beginAuth` accepts a same-origin `next` so the intent survives the OAuth/magic-link callbackURL.
- **Deferred honestly:** the real H5 essay (D-P1.17-1); Stage-B live legs (D-P1.17-2).

## Test matrix (AC → test)

| # | Acceptance criterion | Test |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `/` renders the 12 sections in order; `/invite` keeps the gate | web `marketing.test.ts`: section order, `/invite` intact |
| 2 | Hero drop-zone: .md/.docx/.pdf/paste, ≤10 MB, client hold → post-auth project | `marketing.test.ts` (markup + affordance), `client/landing.test.ts` (hold → beacon → `/signup?intent=review&held=1` → `/app/new` DataTransfer claim w/ fake-indexeddb; oversize + unsupported-ext refuses; paste; claimed-ghost; no-IDB degrade) |
| 3 | Sign-up → app ≤60 s, zero modals, word/citation counts shown | `marketing.test.ts` (signup intent carry), `/app/new` existing preview flow + held pickup; live ≤20 s leg is D-P1.17-2 |
| 4 | `/pricing` renders ladder/cards/matrix/FAQ — all derived | `packages/contracts/src/domain/pricing-page.test.ts`: figures == `buildPricingPageData()`; ranges are two numbers; essay first; annual $ math; FAQ's 8k answer generated; `marketing.test.ts` renders the same model |
| 5 | Copy lints red on generation promise (hero/proof), detection-evasion, logo placeholder, unbuilt asset, unflagged comparative | `pricing-page.test.ts` `lintGrowthCopy` describes + `copy.test.ts` running the real COPY through the lint |
| 6 | Headline locked to the §15.1 string | `lintGrowthCopy` `hero_headline` rule + `HERO_HEADLINE` pin + landing render |
| 7 | Showcase seeded per account at provision, idempotent | `packages/db/src/seed/showcase.test.ts` + api `showcase.test.ts`: provision → one showcase project; repeat → same one |
| 8 | Showcase dossier renders letter/claims/findings/run card; ≥1 contradicted tier-1 + fetched URL | `showcase.test.ts` + `assertShowcaseFixture` |
| 9 | Showcase read-only: runs blocked inline, draft writes refuse; Duplicate → normal project; archive/restore ok; delete refused | `showcase.test.ts` (api routes + guards) |
| 10 | Precedence: dropped file → first screen is that project, showcase second row; else showcase dossier on finding 1 | `marketing.test.ts` /app precedence block (intent, query fallback, opened/archived = a row, dossier deep-link on finding 1) |
| 11 | §3.5 events emit w/ envelope; opt-out suppresses | `showcase.test.ts` §3.5 acquisition block + `analytics-routes.test.ts` (whitelist/opt-out) + web emit seams + `emission-audit.test.ts` |
| 12 | Dark default, light theme real, theme stamped pre-paint | `marketing.test.ts` (data-theme stamped on the SSR root; THEME_CSS vars on landing selectors) |
| 13 | Reveals ≤200 ms, reduced-motion static, LCP<2.5 s/CLS<0.05 budgets | `marketing.test.ts` asserts no reveal scaffolding (static SSR ⇒ budgets hold structurally); the live Lighthouse/axe measure is D-P1.17-2 |
| 14 | 8k-docx → preview < 20 s (deterministic converter) | the import path's existing preview coverage (`import.test.ts` wait/poll semantics); the live wall-clock bound is D-P1.17-2 |
